title: The BigScience ROOTS Corpus: A 1.6TB Composite Multilingual Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the distribution of textual data (byte counts, document sizes, and token-per-byte fertility) across 46 natural languages, 9 language families, and 3 macroareas to evaluate linguistic representation and diversity.

Auditing and manually refining flagged word lists used for data filtering to ensure terms related to race, sexual orientation, and non-pornographic medical/scientific contexts are not disproportionately censored or excluded from the corpus.
